concepts.label: Fortran module
concepts.description: Fortran MODULE groups declarations and procedures; USE brings a module's accessible names into scope.

concepts.label: Fortran allocatable arrays
concepts.description: Allocatable variables obtain storage at runtime, often with ALLOCATE and automatic deallocation on scope exit.

concepts.label: Fortran coarray programming
concepts.description: Coarrays support SPMD-style programming with images and synchronization constructs.

concepts.label: Fortran PURE procedure
concepts.description: PURE procedures have restrictions on side effects and argument modifications.

concepts.label: Fortran C interoperability
concepts.description: ISO_C_BINDING and BIND(C) expose interoperable types and procedures across Fortran and C.

concepts.label: C pointer lifetime
concepts.description: Manual storage management requires ownership discipline and correct allocation/deallocation pairing.

concepts.label: C++ RAII
concepts.description: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization ties resource lifetime to object lifetime and deterministic destruction.

concepts.label: C++ templates
concepts.description: Compile-time parameterization supports generic functions and types.

concepts.label: C++ move semantics
concepts.description: Move operations transfer resources between objects where type-specific move behavior permits.

concepts.label: Rust ownership
concepts.description: Ownership and move rules establish which value owns a resource; borrowing controls references.

concepts.label: Rust lifetimes
concepts.description: Lifetimes describe reference validity relationships without extending object lifetime.

concepts.label: Rust traits
concepts.description: Traits describe shared behavioral interfaces and constraints on generic types.

concepts.label: Go goroutines
concepts.description: Goroutines are lightweight concurrently executing functions scheduled by the Go runtime.

concepts.label: Go channels
concepts.description: Channels exchange typed values and can coordinate goroutines.

concepts.label: Go interfaces
concepts.description: Interface satisfaction is structural and based on method sets.

concepts.label: Python asyncio
concepts.description: The asyncio event loop coordinates coroutine execution and asynchronous I/O.

concepts.label: Python GIL
concepts.description: CPython threading behavior depends on interpreter builds and runtime version, including GIL variants.

concepts.label: Java CompletableFuture
concepts.description: CompletableFuture composes asynchronous results and completion stages.

concepts.label: Java synchronization
concepts.description: Java monitors and synchronized blocks provide mutual exclusion and memory visibility guarantees.

concepts.label: C# async Task
concepts.description: Task and async/await represent asynchronous operations in .NET.

concepts.label: Kotlin coroutines
concepts.description: Suspend functions and structured concurrency represent asynchronous work.

concepts.label: Swift structured concurrency
concepts.description: Swift async/await, tasks, and actors help structure concurrent code.

concepts.label: OpenMP parallel regions
concepts.description: OpenMP directives or pragmas define shared-memory parallel regions and data-sharing properties.

concepts.label: MPI message passing
concepts.description: MPI processes communicate through explicit collective and point-to-point operations.

concepts.label: CUDA kernels
concepts.description: CUDA launches device kernels with explicitly managed execution configuration and memory semantics.
